dedupe_keys.name: stb rail service data weekly class i railroad performance reports

description: The Rail Service Data collection holds the weekly performance reports that US Class I railroads file with the Surface Transportation Board under docket EP 724. The reports provide time series of system train speed by train type, terminal dwell, cars online by car type, trains held per day by type and cause, cars not moved in 48 hours, grain and coal train performance, carloads by commodity, and Chicago gateway yard counts and trains held short. Coverage is the national Class I network, reported weekly by each carrier. Access: free downloads of the individual filings and a consolidated spreadsheet on the STB website, as US Government public information. Caveats: the data are filed by the railroads themselves, carriers file corrections after the fact, and the reporting rules have been amended over time. It supports rail service performance benchmarking, congestion and disruption analysis (for example, recovery after winter storms or floods), and calibration of freight rail capacity models, and complements the STB Carload Waybill Sample catalogued here.
